input: Did the 5 MW SunRidge Community Solar garden generate enough surplus kWh to cover all 1,200 residential subscription credits this month?

**The 5 MW SunRidge Community Solar facility generated 745,000 kWh this billing cycle, successfully exceeding the aggregate subscription requirement of 600,000 kWh needed to cover all 1,200 residential subscribers.** **A net surplus of 145,000 kWh (24.17% above total subscriber demand) was achieved, enabling 100% on-bill credit allocation with zero curtailment or unfulfilled subscriber shares.** **Excess generation will be routed to the reserve banking pool in accordance with PUC community solar tariff provisions.**

---

| Metric | Current Value | Baseline / Target | Delta (%) | Status (Normal/Warning/Critical) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Total Facility Generation** | 745,000 kWh | 680,000 kWh (P50 Forecast) | +9.56% | Normal |
| **Active Residential Subscribers** | 1,200 accounts | 1,200 accounts | 0.00% | Normal |
| **Aggregate Subscriber Credit Demand** | 600,000 kWh | 600,000 kWh | 0.00% | Normal |
| **Average Allocation per Subscriber** | 500 kWh/subscriber | 500 kWh/subscriber | 0.00% | Normal |
| **Net Surplus / Banking Credit** | 145,000 kWh | 80,000 kWh | +81.25% | Normal |
| **Subscription Coverage Ratio** | 124.17% | 100.00% | +24.17% | Normal |

---

### Visualization Triggers
- **Recommended Chart**: Categorical Bar Chart illustrating Total Generation vs. Subscribed Demand Allocation vs. Net Surplus.

```json
{
  "chart_type": "bar",
  "title": "SunRidge 5 MW Community Solar Monthly Generation & Credit Distribution",

      {
        "label": "Energy (kWh)",

        "title": { "display": true, "text": "Kilowatt-Hours (kWh)" },

      }
    }
  }
}
```

---

### Actionable Recommendations
- **Execute Bill Credit Distribution**: Apply the allocated 500 kWh average credit equivalent directly to the 1,200 active residential billing profiles for the current cycle.
- **Credit Banking Allocation**: Transfer the 145,000 kWh net generation surplus into the facility's rolling subscriber credit bank to hedge against lower winter irradiance cycles.
- **Subscriber Portfolio Review**: Evaluate waitlist onboarding capacity, as consistent surplus headroom indicates potential to support an additional 200–250 residential subscriptions under standard allocation rules.

---

input: What is the financial credit leakage rate resulting from delayed subscriber churn updates in the billing engine?
expected_output:
### Executive Summary
**Delayed subscriber churn synchronization creates an aggregate financial credit leakage rate of 3.85% across active community solar portfolios, representing an annualized unrecovered variance of $1.86M. The root cause stems from a 22-day median processing lag between customer account termination in the CIS/CRM and bill-credit re-allocation execution within the billing engine. Automated intra-cycle reallocation triggers are required to eliminate stranded value-stack credits applied to closed customer accounts.**

---

### Data Presentation

| Metric | Current Value | Baseline / Target | Delta (%) | Status (Normal/Warning/Critical) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Credit Leakage Rate (% of Total Net Crediting)** | **3.85%** | **≤ 0.50%** | **+670.0%** | **Critical** |
| **Monthly Stranded Credit Value ($)** | **$154,600** | **<$20,000** | **+673.0%** | **Critical** |
| **Median Churn Processing Latency (Days)** | **22.4 Days** | **≤ 3.0 Days** | **+646.7%** | **Critical** |
| **Unallocated Generation Volume (MWh/mo)** | **1,288.3 MWh** | **<150.0 MWh** | **+758.9%** | **Critical** |
| **Over-credited Closed Accounts (Monthly Count)** | **412 Accounts** | **0 Accounts** | **N/A** | **Warning** |
| **Developer True-up Settlement Variance ($)** | **$89,200** | **<$10,000** | **+792.0%** | **Critical** |

---

### Visualization Triggers
**Recommended Visualization:** *Grouped Bar Chart (Financial Credit Leakage & Unallocated Volume by Processing Lag Tier)*

```json
{
  "chart_type": "bar",
  "title": "Financial Credit Leakage by Billing Cycle Lag (Community Solar)",
  "categories": [
    "Same-Cycle (0-5 Days)",
    "Next-Cycle (6-30 Days)",
    "Extended Lag (31-60 Days)",
    "Severe Backlog (>60 Days)"
  ],
  "series": [
    {
      "name": "Credit Leakage ($k/Month)",
      "data": [4.2, 18.7, 42.1, 89.6]

    {
      "name": "Unallocated kWh (MWh)",

    }

```

---

### Actionable Recommendations

- **Automate CIS-to-Billing Churn Webhooks:** Deploy real-time account closure event listeners to instantly unassign solar subscription capacity within `<24 hours` of meter finalization rather than relying on monthly batch exports.
- **Implement a Dynamic Anchor/Buffer Subscription Pool:** Route churned generation percentages directly to default host or institutional anchor subscribers (e.g., municipal accounts) to prevent credit expiration or misdirection to closed premise accounts.
- **Backbill & Clawback Reconciliation Audit:** Initiate a targeted clawback audit on the 412 closed accounts that received erroneous post-move-out solar credits during the last 90-day settlement window.
- **Align Net Metering / VDER Credit Roll-Over Policies:** Adjust billing calculation rules to retain unallocated subscriber credits in the facility master bank until subscriber replacement onboarding is confirmed.

---

```json
}
```
